169.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field, unless it uses Baton Pass, in which case the target will remain trapped.
169.shortDescription: Prevents the target from switching out.

170.name: Mind Reader
170.description: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. When this effect is started against the target, this and Lock-On's effects end for every other Pokemon against that target. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement remains under this effect. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, this effect is restarted against the same target for the replacement. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
170.shortDescription: User's next move will not miss the target.

171.name: Nightmare
171.description: Causes the target to lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn as long as it is asleep. This move does not affect the target unless it is asleep. The effect ends when the target wakes up, even if it falls asleep again in the same turn.
171.shortDescription: A sleeping target is hurt by 1/4 max HP per turn.

172.name: Flame Wheel
172.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
172.shortDescription: 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.

173.name: Snore
173.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.
173.shortDescription: User must be asleep. 30% chance to flinch target.

174.name: Curse
174.description: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected or has a substitute.
174.shortDescription: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.

175.name: Flail
175.description: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
175.shortDescription: More power the less HP the user has left.

176.name: Conversion 2
176.description: The user's type changes to match a type that resists or is immune to the type of the last move used against the user, if it was successful against the user, but not either of its current types. The determined type of the move is used rather than the original type, but considers Struggle as Normal. Fails if the last move used against the user was not successful, or if this move would only be able to select one of the user's current types.
176.shortDescription: User's type changes to resist last move against it.

177.name: Aeroblast
177.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

178.name: Cotton Spore
178.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

179.name: Reversal
179.description: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
179.shortDescription: More power the less HP the user has left.

180.name: Spite
180.description: Causes the target's last move used to lose 2 to 5 PP, at random. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 or 1 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.
180.shortDescription: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 2-5.

181.name: Powder Snow
181.description: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

182.name: Protect
182.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has an X/65536 chance of being successful, where X starts at 65535 and halves, rounded down, each time this move is successfully used. After the fourth successful use in a row, X drops to 118 and continues with seemingly random values from 0-65535 on subsequent successful uses. X resets to 65535 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Detect, Endure, or Protect. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
182.shortDescription: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

184.name: Scary Face
184.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

185.name: Feint Attack
185.description: This move does not check accuracy.
185.shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

186.name: Sweet Kiss
186.description: Causes the target to become confused.
186.shortDescription: Causes the target to become confused.

187.name: Belly Drum
187.description: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.
187.shortDescription: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.

188.name: Sludge Bomb
188.description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

189.name: Mud-Slap
189.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
189.shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

190.name: Octazooka
190.description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
190.shortDescription: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

191.name: Spikes
191.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin successfully.
191.shortDescription: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

192.name: Zap Cannon
192.description: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

193.name: Foresight
193.description: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type.
193.shortDescription: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.

194.name: Destiny Bond
194.description: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight.
194.shortDescription: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.

195.name: Perish Song
195.description: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.
195.shortDescription: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.

196.name: Icy Wind
196.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
196.shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

197.name: Detect
197.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has an X/65536 chance of being successful, where X starts at 65535 and halves, rounded down, each time this move is successfully used. After the fourth successful use in a row, X drops to 118 and continues with seemingly random values from 0-65535 on subsequent successful uses. X resets to 65535 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Detect, Endure, or Protect. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
197.shortDescription: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

198.name: Bone Rush
198.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 3/8 chance to hit two or three times, and a 1/8 chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits.

199.name: Lock-On
199.description: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. When this effect is started against the target, this and Mind Reader's effects end for every other Pokemon against that target. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement remains under this effect. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, this effect is restarted against the same target for the replacement. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
199.shortDescription: User's next move will not miss the target.

200.name: Outrage
200.description: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused at the end of the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, falls asleep, becomes frozen, or the attack is not successful against the target, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
200.shortDescription: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

201.name: Sandstorm
201.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Sand Veil Ability. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.

202.name: Giga Drain
202.description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded down.
202.shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

203.name: Endure
203.description: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has an X/65536 chance of being successful, where X starts at 65535 and halves, rounded down, each time this move is successfully used. After the fourth successful use in a row, X drops to 118 and continues with seemingly random values from 0-65535 on subsequent successful uses. X resets to 65535 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Detect, Endure, or Protect. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
203.shortDescription: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.

204.name: Charm
204.description: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

205.name: Rollout
205.description: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.
205.shortDescription: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.

206.name: False Swipe
206.description: Leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
206.shortDescription: Always leaves the target with at least 1 HP.

207.name: Swagger
207.description: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.
207.shortDescription: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.

208.name: Milk Drink
208.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
208.shortDescription: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

209.name: Spark
209.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

210.name: Fury Cutter
210.description: Power doubles with each successful hit, up to a maximum of 160 power. The power is reset if this move misses or another move is used.
210.shortDescription: Power doubles with each hit, up to 160.

211.name: Steel Wing
211.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
211.shortDescription: 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

212.name: Mean Look
212.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field, unless it uses Baton Pass, in which case the target will remain trapped.
212.shortDescription: Prevents the target from switching out.

213.name: Attract
213.description: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability are immune.
213.shortDescription: A target of the opposite gender gets infatuated.

214.name: Sleep Talk
214.description: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, but if it currently has 0 PP it will fail to be used. This move cannot select Assist, Bide, Focus Punch, Metronome, Mirror Move, Sleep Talk, Uproar, or any two-turn move.
214.shortDescription: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.

215.name: Heal Bell
215.description: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured.
215.shortDescription: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

216.name: Return
216.description: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

217.name: Present
217.description: If this move is successful, it deals damage or heals the target. 40% chance for 40 power, 30% chance for 80 power, 10% chance for 120 power, and 20% chance to heal the target by 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
217.shortDescription: 40, 80, 120 power, or heals target 1/4 max HP.

218.name: Frustration
218.description: Power is equal to the greater of ((255 - user's Happiness) * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

219.name: Safeguard
219.description: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
219.shortDescription: For 5 turns, protects user's party from status.

220.name: Pain Split
220.description: The user and the target's HP become the average of their current HP, rounded down, but not more than the maximum HP of either one.
220.shortDescription: Shares HP of user and target equally.

221.name: Sacred Fire
221.description: Has a 50% chance to burn the target.
221.shortDescription: 50% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.

222.name: Magnitude
222.description: The power of this move varies. 5% chances for 10 and 150 power, 10% chances for 30 and 110 power, 20% chances for 50 and 90 power, and 30% chance for 70 power. Power doubles if the target is using Dig.
222.shortDescription: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Power varies; 2x on Dig.

223.name: Dynamic Punch
223.description: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

225.name: Dragon Breath
225.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

226.name: Baton Pass
226.description: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Curse, Focus Energy, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Mud Sport, Perish Song, Water Sport, the trapper or trapped effects of Mean Look (Block, Spider Web), and a substitute with its remaining HP.
226.shortDescription: User switches, passing stat changes and more.

227.name: Encore
227.description: For 3 to 6 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform.
227.shortDescription: The target repeats its last move for 3-6 turns.

228.name: Pursuit
228.description: If the target is an opposing Pokemon and it switches out this turn, this move hits that Pokemon before it leaves the field. Power doubles and no accuracy check is done if the user hits an opponent switching out, and the user's turn is over; if an opponent faints from this, the replacement Pokemon becomes active immediately.
228.shortDescription: Power doubles if the targeted foe is switching out.

229.name: Rapid Spin
229.description: If this move is successful, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and Spikes are removed from the user's side of the field.
229.shortDescription: Frees user from hazards, binding, Leech Seed.

230.name: Sweet Scent
230.description: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage.

231.name: Iron Tail
231.description: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
231.shortDescription: 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

232.name: Metal Claw
232.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
232.shortDescription: 10% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

233.name: Vital Throw
233.description: This move does not check accuracy.
233.shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy. Goes last.

234.name: Morning Sun
234.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if no weather conditions are in effect, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, all rounded down.
234.shortDescription: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

235.name: Synthesis
235.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if no weather conditions are in effect, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, all rounded down.
235.shortDescription: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

236.name: Moonlight
236.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if no weather conditions are in effect, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, all rounded down.
236.shortDescription: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

237.name: Hidden Power
237.description: This move's type and power depend on the user's individual values (IVs). Power varies between 30 and 70, and type can be any but Normal.
237.shortDescription: Varies in power and type based on the user's IVs.

238.name: Cross Chop
238.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

239.name: Twister
239.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce or Fly.
239.shortDescription: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

240.name: Rain Dance
240.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain Dance. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Fails if the current weather is Rain Dance.
240.shortDescription: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.

241.name: Sunny Day
241.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sunny Day. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Fails if the current weather is Sunny Day.
241.shortDescription: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.

242.name: Crunch
242.description: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
242.shortDescription: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

243.name: Mirror Coat
243.description: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. This move considers Hidden Power as Normal type, and only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn, or if the user did not lose HP from the attack.
243.shortDescription: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.

244.name: Psych Up
244.description: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.
244.shortDescription: Copies the target's current stat stages.

246.name: Ancient Power
246.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
246.shortDescription: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

247.name: Shadow Ball
247.description: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
247.shortDescription: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

248.name: Future Sight
248.description: Deals typeless damage that cannot be a critical hit two turns after this move is used. Damage is calculated against the target on use, and at the end of the final turn that damage is dealt to the Pokemon at the position the original target had at the time. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.
248.shortDescription: Hits two turns after being used.

249.name: Rock Smash
249.description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
249.shortDescription: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

250.name: Whirlpool
250.description: Prevents the target from switching for two to five turns. Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
250.shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 2-5 turns.

251.name: Beat Up
251.description: Deals typeless damage. Hits one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party, or fails if no Pokemon meet the criteria. For each hit, the damage formula uses the participating Pokemon's base Attack as the Attack stat, the target's base Defense as the Defense stat, and ignores stat stages and other effects that modify Attack or Defense; each hit is considered to come from the user.
251.shortDescription: All healthy allies aid in damaging the target.

252.name: Fake Out
252.description: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
252.shortDescription: Hits first. First turn out only. 100% flinch chance.

253.name: Uproar
253.description: The user spends two to five turns locked into this move. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. During effect, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon that are already asleep wake up as their turn starts or at the end of each turn, including the last one. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
253.shortDescription: Lasts 2-5 turns. Active Pokemon cannot sleep.

254.name: Stockpile
254.description: The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.
254.shortDescription: Raises user's Stockpile count by 1. Max 3 uses.

255.name: Spit Up
255.description: Damage is multiplied by the user's Stockpile count. This move does not apply damage variance and cannot be a critical hit. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Unless this move misses, the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
255.shortDescription: More power with more uses of Stockpile.

256.name: Swallow
256.description: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
256.shortDescription: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.

257.name: Heat Wave
257.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

258.name: Hail
258.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type. Fails if the current weather is Hail.

259.name: Torment
259.description: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
259.shortDescription: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.

260.name: Flatter
260.description: Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.
260.shortDescription: Raises the target's Sp. Atk by 1 and confuses it.

262.name: Memento
262.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. The user faints. This move does not check accuracy, and can hit targets in the middle of a two-turn move. Fails entirely if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages are both -6.
262.shortDescription: Lowers target's Attack, Sp. Atk by 2. User faints.

263.name: Facade
263.description: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
263.shortDescription: Power doubles if user is burn/poison/paralyzed.

264.name: Focus Punch
264.description: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move, but it still loses PP.
264.shortDescription: Fails if the user takes damage before it hits.

265.name: Smelling Salts
265.description: Damage doubles if the target is paralyzed. If this move is successful, the target is cured of paralysis.
265.shortDescription: Damage doubles if target is paralyzed; cures it.

266.name: Follow Me
266.description: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod Ability. This effect remains active even if the user leaves the field. Fails if it is not a Double Battle.
266.shortDescription: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.

267.name: Nature Power
267.description: This move calls another move for use depending on the battle terrain. Swift in Wi-Fi battles.

268.name: Charge
268.description: If the user uses an Electric-type attack on the next turn, its power will be doubled.
268.shortDescription: The user's Electric attack next turn has 2x power.

269.name: Taunt
269.description: For 2 turns, prevents the target from using non-damaging moves.
269.shortDescription: For 2 turns, the target can't use status moves.

270.name: Helping Hand
270.description: The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.
270.shortDescription: One adjacent ally's move power is 1.5x this turn.

271.name: Trick
271.description: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail, if neither is holding an item, if either is under the effect of Knock Off, or if the target has the Sticky Hold Ability.
271.shortDescription: User switches its held item with the target's.

272.name: Role Play
272.description: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the target's Ability is Wonder Guard.
272.shortDescription: User replaces its Ability with the target's.

273.name: Wish
273.description: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of its maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
273.shortDescription: Next turn, heals 50% of the recipient's max HP.

274.name: Assist
274.description: A random move among those known by the user's party members is selected for use. Does not select Assist, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Endure, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Protect, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Thief, or Trick.
274.shortDescription: Uses a random move known by a team member.

275.name: Ingrain
275.description: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, and the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect.
275.shortDescription: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn. Traps user.

276.name: Superpower
276.description: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
276.shortDescription: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

277.name: Magic Coat
277.description: The user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. If the move targets both opposing Pokemon and the Pokemon under this effect is on the left side, it will reflect the move targeting both opposing Pokemon and its ally will not be affected by the original move; otherwise, if the Pokemon under this effect is on the right side, its ally will be affected by the original move and this Pokemon will reflect the move only targeting the original user. The effect ends once a move is reflected or at the end of the turn. Moves reflected in this way can be reflected again by another Pokemon under this effect. If the user has the Soundproof Ability, it nullifies sound-based moves before this effect happens. The Lightning Rod Ability redirects Electric moves before this move takes effect.

278.name: Recycle
278.description: The user regains the item last used by a Pokemon in its current position on the field, even if that Pokemon was not the user. Fails if the user is holding an item, if no items have been used at the user's position, or if the item was lost to Covet, Knock Off, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
278.shortDescription: Restores the item the user last used.

279.name: Revenge
